test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) GED

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b0defce70d6f1faa2ec13c6a63524ffc4bab5417f6b714c3ac3e1d28716a946.png] 

Option 2) ZXW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/671a0513eace6f736f0c87fe71cf7c46777f85cd9d63491b8a36a8e6eff631d4.png] 

Option 3) HFE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe8b0dd514f15fb5081dbb3472e5992104f3fb227617365e1754415c0b3f732a.png] 

Option 4) MLJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55b4b2504e28158a9d5f566b8effd006ee734fae67e008c3e5be58a3ee04143e.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'MLJ' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
